[[File:DecipherCon 2002 Day 1A pairings.jpg|thumb|right|260px|At the [[2002 World Championship]].]]
'''Andrew Howard''' was listed as '''Tournament Support Advocate''' on the early swccgpc.com Advocate Council, succeeding [[John Arendt]] in that role.<ref name="swccgpc2002home">[https://web.archive.org/web/20021106101746/http://www.swccgpc.com/ The SWCCG Player's Committee], swccgpc.com (Wayback, 6 November 2002)</ref><ref name="council2002">[https://web.archive.org/web/20021209221742/http://www.swccgpc.com/council.htm Advocate Council], swccgpc.com (Wayback, 9 December 2002)</ref>

The Players Committee announced on 24 October 2002 that Howard was joining as the new Advocate for the Tournament Department, replacing [[John Arendt]].<ref name="pc-oct02">[http://www.swccgpc.com/Archives/october02archives.htm October Updates], swccgpc.com (24 October 2002). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20030423222342/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/Archives/october02archives.htm Internet Archive]</ref> He received official word of the appointment about a week before [[DecipherCon 2002]], and on 30 October 2002 he and fellow Advocate [[Eric Olson]] left for Norfolk, Virginia, and the [[2002 World Championship]].<ref name="pc-dconwrap" /> Toward the end of 2002 he announced the four-tier 2003 Championship Circuit and an exclusive partnership between the PC and Decktech Inc. ([[DeckTech]]), whose co-sponsored DPC Championship Series let players qualify for the World Championships and win cash.<ref name="pc-rtw03">[http://www.swccgpc.com/News/Events/2003/roadtoworlds03.htm Road to Worlds Begins in 2003; SWCCG Player's Committee Announces Strategic Partnership], swccgpc.com (late 2002). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040620161313/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/News/Events/2003/roadtoworlds03.htm Internet Archive]</ref> On 6 February 2003 he announced a swccgpc.com facelift (a frames format, a resource page, Advocate biographies and a Shadow Squadron volunteer database)<ref name="pc-feb03">[http://www.swccgpc.com/Archives/february03archives.htm February Updates], swccgpc.com (6 February 2003). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20030423221707/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/Archives/february03archives.htm Internet Archive]</ref> and opened applications for the 2003 Championship Circuit, whose first SWCCG Open Qualifier was set for [[2003 MegaCon|MegaCon]] on 1 March 2003.<ref name="pc-champ0203">[http://www.swccgpc.com/News/championshipnews02062003.htm 2003 Championship Circuit Opens in One Month], swccgpc.com (6 February 2003). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20030424053234/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/News/championshipnews02062003.htm Internet Archive]</ref> On 23 March 2003 he moved the start of the State, Provincial and National Championships to 1 May 2003, citing the transition of the PC's product to a new warehouse and the military action in Iraq, which had directly affected him.<ref name="pc-mar03">[http://www.swccgpc.com/Archives/march03archives.htm March Updates], swccgpc.com (23 March 2003). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20030819162615/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/Archives/march03archives.htm Internet Archive]</ref> On 1 April 2003 he announced the opening of the PC's Online Affiliate Store with Universal Cards.<ref name="pc-apr03">[http://www.swccgpc.com/Archives/april03archives.htm April Updates], swccgpc.com (1 April 2003). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20030810085606/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/Archives/april03archives.htm Internet Archive]</ref> In June 2003 he and Eric Olson were the project managers of a PC subcommittee developing independent tournament management software.<ref name="pc-tsw03">[http://www.swccgpc.com/News/tournamentchanges06182003.htm Upcoming Changes to Decipher's Tournament Software; How does it affect you?], swccgpc.com (18 June 2003). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20030809102648/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/News/tournamentchanges06182003.htm Internet Archive]</ref>
